requirements.title: Verify current RO VAT rates (2025 change) against authoritative sources
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Law 141/2025 (published 2025-07-25), effective 2025-08-01: standard 19%->21%, reduced 5%&9% consolidated to 11%, exempt 0% unchanged. Verified via avalara.com, vatupdate.com, globalvatcompliance.com.

requirements.acceptanceEvidence: REGULI_TVA_RO seed: standard 19->21, redus_9/redus_5 -> 11, scutit 0, boundary 2025-08-01 (exclusive validTo).

requirements.acceptanceEvidence: 13 tests green: July/Aug 2025 boundary fixtures, historical determinism (property), explicit-error, calculLinie integration (19% vs 21%).

requirements.acceptanceEvidence: tax_rules table + seed on real SQLite; product cod_categorie_fiscala + backfill; DocumentEditor resolves via engine; read-only admin registry.

requirements.title: Remove unsafe hardcoded VAT defaults + static guard
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: silent 19/9 defaults removed from entity schemas; guard test blocks reintroduction.

requirements.title: Draft/runtime integration of resolved VAT
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: draft lines resolve rate from product category + document date.

migrations: 0012 snapshot columns now populated at posting
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: postDocument resolves each line's rate from persisted tax_rules by category+date and freezes tax_rule_id/version/resolved_tax_rate_bp/category/legal_reference/JSON on the line; verified on real SQLite (21% authoritative vs client 19%, historical 19%, snapshot copied on reversal).

requirements.acceptanceEvidence: transaction(options, work); stable error categories.

requirements.acceptanceEvidence: SQLite BEGIN/SAVEPOINT/COMMIT/ROLLBACK verified on real SQLite; PG dedicated client + retry verified via fake pool + gated real-PG test.

requirements.title: Explicit repository transaction binding (withExecutor)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: withExecutor(tx) binds all repos to tx; atomic rollback across repos proven.

tests: 12 SQLite contract + 7 binding/fault + 6 PG fake-pool + 1 gated real-PG

requirements.title: Phase 2 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: All acceptance criteria met on real SQLite; PostgreSQL implemented + CI-configured but not verified against a real server in this environment.
risks: do not close RK-02 until Phase 3 authoritative commands use transactions

requirements.title: Document aggregate + lifecycle state machine (pure)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: ciorna->aprobat->validat(posted)->stornat|anulat transition table; posted/reversed/cancelled immutable; server-side total recompute; invariant validation. 12 pure unit tests.

requirements.title: Application command layer (@gr/application) — transactional PostDocument + lifecycle
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: postDocument writes document+lines+immutable tax snapshot atomically in ONE exec.transaction (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) via withExecutor(tx); resolves authoritative VAT server-side; allocates legal number at posting; fault injection leaves no partial write and burns no number; createDraft/updateDraft/approve/cancel/reverse. 13 real-SQLite tests.
risks: end-to-end UI/transport wiring per deployment mode is remaining integration (command layer + server guard in place)

requirements.title: Server-side invariant validation + posted-document immutability enforcement
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: totals recomputed server-side (never trust client); generic REST PATCH/DELETE on a posted/reversed/cancelled document rejected (409) for every role; command-layer guard asertaDocumentEditabilPersistat.
risks: local desktop UI (direct SQLite, no server) not yet routed through the guard

requirements.title: Phase 3 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Authoritative transactional command layer + document aggregate implemented and tested on real SQLite; posting is a business event; posted docs immutable. RK-02 closed (document posting is atomic and uses the Phase 2 transaction), RK-04 downgraded (server-enforced immutability).
risks: stock/accounting ledger effects of posting await Phase 5/6 persistence

requirements.title: Optimistic locking (version / expectedVersion + conflict response)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Document.version bumped on every authoritative write; updateDraft/approve/cancel/post/reverse accept expectedVersion; stale version => ConflictOptimistaError (409). Verified on real SQLite.

requirements.title: Idempotency store (key + request hash + stored response)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: cuIdempotenta dedupes within the command transaction; a retried postDocument with the same key returns the stored response and allocates no second number; key reuse for a different request => IdempotencyConflictError; idempotency_keys PK is the concurrency backstop. Verified on real SQLite.

requirements.title: DB unique constraint on document numbering; allocate at authoritative step
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Partial unique index ux_documente_numar on (firma_id, tip, year(data), serie, numar) WHERE numar>0 rejects a duplicate number; drafts (numar 0) don't collide; number allocated at posting (P3). Verified on real SQLite.
risks: index treats NULL firma_id as distinct (SQL standard) — legacy null-firma rows rely on the allocator, not the DB backstop

requirements.title: Phase 4 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Zero duplicate numbers/postings under retry: optimistic locking + idempotent replay + DB unique backstop, all verified on real SQLite. RK-05 downgraded.
risks: true multi-process concurrency exercised on PostgreSQL only in CI (SQLite test is single-connection); real-PG numbering race not run in-env

requirements.title: Persistent append-only stock ledger + materialized balances
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: stock_ledger_entries (append-only, running qty/value/CMP after each move) + stock_balances (materialized current balance) on real SQLite; reports derive from persisted balances/ledger.

requirements.title: CMP valuation, transfer value conservation, explicit negative-stock policy (never clamp)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Pure CMP engine: exits valued at weighted-average cost; transfer dest IN = source OUT (value conserved); negative-stock policy interzice(default)/avertizeaza/permite, never a silent clamp; StocInsuficientError. postDocument emits ledger + upserts balances in the SAME transaction (atomic — insufficient-stock rollback proven); reverseDocument nets the ledger to zero. Verified on real SQLite.
risks: true multi-process oversell prevention (writer lock) meaningful on PostgreSQL/CI; SQLite test is single-connection but exercises the deny path + BEGIN IMMEDIATE

requirements.title: Phase 5 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Stock is a persistent immutable ledger; reports derive from it; value reconciles on transfer; overselling denied by default. RK-03 downgraded (stock persisted; accounting ledger is Phase 6), RK-06 downgraded.
risks: UI reports (useStoc) still recompute in some paths — wiring them to the persisted balances is follow-up integration

requirements.title: Persistent append-only accounting journal (entries + lines)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: journal_entries + journal_lines (append-only, double-entry) on real SQLite; reports derive from the persisted journal.

requirements.title: Balanced per-document notes; effective posting profile; no NIR<->invoice double-count; reversal nets to zero
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: genereazaNotaDocument reuses the contabilitate.ts monografie; every note balanced (asertaNotaEchilibrata); postDocument emits it in the SAME transaction as the document + stock ledger using the stock COGS for inventory discharge; factura_cumparare matched to a posted NIR yields no second note; reverseDocument swaps debit/credit (journal nets to zero); stock<->accounting reconcile (account 371 == stock value). Verified on real SQLite.
risks: posting profile is the fixed RO monografie (contStoc defaults 371); effective-dated profiles + dimensions/periods are a later refinement
requirements.externalValidation: external accountant review (out of code scope)

requirements.title: Phase 6 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Accounting is a persistent immutable double-entry journal, emitted atomically with the document + stock; balanced; reversal nets to zero; stock and accounting reconcile. RK-03 closed (both stock and accounting persisted), RK-07 partially mitigated.
risks: fiscal reports (D300/D394/D390) still derive from documents — Phase 7; external accountant sign-off required for compliance

requirements.title: Persistent append-only fiscal-event ledger
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: fiscal_events (append-only: direction, rate, base, VAT, partner, country, context) written at posting on real SQLite; declarations read facts, not document lists.

requirements.title: D300 base from events; no NIR<->invoice double-count; reconcile to journal; reversal nets to zero
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: genereazaEvenimenteFiscaleDocument (direction by type, grouped by posted-line rate) respects the shared 3-way NIR match; decontDinEvenimente computes the VAT return from events; postDocument emits events atomically; reverseDocument negates them. Verified on real SQLite: deductible VAT counted once across NIR+invoice; events reconcile to journal 4426/4427; reversal nets the decont to zero.
risks: D394/D390 recap forms still read the document-based fiscal-ro helpers; pointing them fully at the event ledger + official ANAF XML/validator is remaining (EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED)
requirements.externalValidation: official ANAF D300/D394/D390 validators (cannot run in-env)

requirements.title: Phase 7 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Fiscal facts are a persistent ledger written atomically at posting; the VAT return derives from events (not document lists), reconciles to the accounting journal, and reversal nets to zero. RK-07 closed at the source (double-count eliminated).
risks: official declaration XML + ANAF validator sign-off is a commercial-readiness gate (external, out of code scope)

requirements.title: Durable e-Factura SPV state machine + persisted submissions
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: efactura_submissions persists a per-document lifecycle (ciorna_xml->validat->incarcat->acceptat|respins, eroare=retryable) with ANAF upload index / status / download id; pure state machine enforces transitions; partial unique index prevents a second active submission. Verified on real SQLite.

requirements.title: CIUS-RO XML from posted invoice + structural validation; idempotent upload/poll
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: pregatesteEfactura builds CIUS-RO UBL XML from the posted invoice + firma + partener, validates structurally, persists (idempotent). incarcaEfactura uploads via an injected uploader (no real ANAF call in-env), idempotent (a retry never re-submits; the uploader is called once across retries); transport failure -> retryable eroare; inregistreazaRaspunsSpv records accept/reject. Verified on real SQLite with a fake uploader.
risks: official ANAF/SPV XSD + CIUS-RO business-rule validation and a real SPV round-trip cannot run in-env (no ANAF credentials) — EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
digital signature + real SPV transport live in the server/desktop integration, not the command layer
requirements.externalValidation: official ANAF e-Factura validator + live SPV (cannot run in-env)

requirements.title: Phase 8 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: An invoice has a durable, auditable SPV lifecycle; XML is built from the posted document and structurally valid; upload is idempotent (no double submission under retry). RK-08 downgraded. Real ANAF validation/round-trip remains an external gate.
risks: real SPV round-trip + official validator sign-off is a commercial-readiness gate

requirements.title: SAF-T General Ledger from the persisted journal + reconciliation + XML
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: agregaGeneralLedger (per-account turnover + closing balance) + reconciliazaGeneralLedger (balanced); genereazaSaftXML emits GeneralLedgerAccounts + GeneralLedgerEntries from persisted journal_lines (was a document-only subset). listeazaLiniiJurnalInterval added.

requirements.title: Application SAF-T builder from ledgers; reconciles to trial balance
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: genereazaSaftDinRegistre assembles the D406 AuditFile from persisted ledgers (journal + master data + invoices) for a period and returns the GL reconciliation. Verified on real SQLite: SAF-T GL totals equal journal_lines debit/credit sums; GeneralLedgerEntries present; interval restricts the period.
risks: official ANAF SAF-T XSD + business-rule validation cannot run in-env — EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED; opening balances / full D406 field coverage are later refinements
requirements.externalValidation: official ANAF SAF-T validator (cannot run in-env)

requirements.title: Phase 9 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: SAF-T is generated from the persisted ledgers and reconciles to the trial balance (GL balanced; totals == journal); structural validity checked. RK-09 downgraded. Official ANAF validator sign-off remains an external gate.
risks: official SAF-T validator + full D406 field coverage is a commercial-readiness gate

requirements.title: Per-firm period close enforced at the posting command
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: documentBlocatPentruFirma + asertaPerioadaDeschisa; postDocument/reverseDocument reject posting into the document firm's closed period (PerioadaInchisaError); server perioadaBlocataPentru now per-firm (was global celMaiRecentBlocaj). Verified on real SQLite: firm A's close rejects firm-A posting; firm B posts normally.

requirements.title: Firm-scoped ledger reports (no cross-company leakage)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: genereazaDecontDinRegistre + genereazaSaftDinRegistre filter by firma_id (fiscal_events / journal_lines queries are firm-scoped). Verified on real SQLite: firm A's VAT return and SAF-T GL never include firm B's ledger data.
risks: rows with firma_id IS NULL remain globally visible (legacy pre-scoping data) — new posted rows carry firma_id; a full backfill/scope-migration is a later refinement

requirements.title: Phase 10 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Period close is per-firm and enforced at the authoritative posting step; firm-scoped reports show no cross-company leakage for posted (firma-stamped) data. RK-10 downgraded.
risks: legacy null-firma rows are still globally visible until a scope-migration/backfill

requirements.title: Session freshness — fresh role/firma + session version
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: session token carries sessionVersion; sesiuneProaspata (pure) rejects a deactivated user or stale session version and returns role/firma read fresh from the DB user (not the stale token). verificaCerere uses it, so a role/company change takes effect on the next request rather than at token expiry (up to 12h). 6 server unit tests + auth round-trip.

requirements.title: Force logout everywhere on password change; hardening
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: invalideazaSesiuni bumps session_version to invalidate ALL of a user's sessions; wired into self password-change and admin password-reset so a stolen token on another device is rejected immediately. Existing per-request RBAC + immutability + period-close + firma guards remain enforced server-side.
risks: revocation/version stores are in-memory per process — a multi-instance deployment needs a shared store (Redis); a full independent pen-test is an external commercial gate
requirements.externalValidation: independent penetration test (external, out of code scope)

requirements.title: Phase 11 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Role/company change and revocation take effect promptly (fresh role from DB + session version), not only at token expiry; password change forces logout everywhere. RK-11 downgraded.
risks: shared revocation store for multi-instance + independent pen-test are commercial-readiness gates

requirements.title: Conflict-aware reconciliation — posted/ledger data never LWW-overwritten
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: reconcileSigur: a server-locked (posted/immutable) record is never overwritten by a client push; a local edit to it is reported as a conflict and the server version is pulled, not merged. New offline drafts still push; non-locked config keeps LWW. 4 pure tests.

requirements.title: Idempotent offline command replay (commands, not row upserts)
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Offline financial changes are queued as commands with idempotency keys; comenziDeReluat skips already-executed keys so a replayed post is idempotent (pairs with the Phase 4 idempotency store / postDocument idempotencyKey). 4 pure tests.
risks: the client transport wiring (persisting the queue + replaying against the API provider) is remaining UI/transport integration

requirements.title: Phase 12 overall
requirements.acceptanceEvidence: Posted/ledger data is protected from last-write-wins (conflicts rejected, not merged); offline replay is command-based and idempotent. RK-12 downgraded.
risks: wiring the offline queue + safe reconciliation into the client transport is remaining integration
